# Time Appliance Repair

> Time Appliance Repair is a Charlotte, NC repair company: commercial refrigeration and kitchen equipment repair, HVAC diagnostics and repair, and residential appliance repair, serving 20 communities in North Carolina and South Carolina.

## Business facts
- Phone: (980) 990-2911
- Email: timeappliancerepair@gmail.com
- Website: https://timeapplianceservice.com/
- Business hours (Eastern Time): Monday to Saturday 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Sunday 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM.
- Service call: $135. If the customer approves the repair, the service call is free. If the customer declines the repair, the $135 applies.
- Offer: $50 off labor on the first repair (cannot be combined with other offers).
- Warranty: 30-day labor warranty and 90-day parts warranty on completed repairs.
- Emergency visits for commercial refrigeration are available on request.
- Google reviews: 5.0 stars from 35 reviews (https://maps.app.goo.gl/cVhcT5eVvE99Jtu37).

## Services
- Commercial equipment (refrigeration, ice machines, kitchen equipment): https://timeapplianceservice.com/commercial-equipment-repair/
- HVAC repair, diagnostics and maintenance (existing systems): https://timeapplianceservice.com/hvac-repair/
- Residential appliance repair: https://timeapplianceservice.com/residential-appliance-repair/
